additional_info.subject: Issue
additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens Support Team,
this morning the charger jX6vQY reported an op
en door (DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4).
There was no on-site activity during this time and the error occured without any interaction with the charger.
The charger is currently out of order and will show an operating screen ("shutdown" resp. "reboot"). This affects availability of the charger and charger security is proned to customer accessibility.
Please immediately assign a field technician to solve the issue, since it does not belong to operator responsibility, furthermore to hypersensitivity of the door position switch.
Kind regards,
Marius Schneider
Software Version: v4.0.11-0-g0b7d164+SF-RETOPICS (PRODUCTION)
OCPP Backend Connection: Yes
